name: com.unity.splines
description: Work with curves and paths. Use the Splines package to generate objects and behaviors along paths, create trajectories, and draw shapes.

samples.description: Example code and scenes files showing how to use Splines.

_upm.changelog:
### Fixed

- [UUM-156597] Fixed the `SplineContainer` Inspector flickering when the same container is shown in multiple Inspector windows.
- [UUM-158683] Fixed a non-uniformly scaled `SplineContainer` evaluating the wrong spline in world space after its transform changed.
- [UUM-158910] Fixed the `SplineFactory.CreateRoundedSquare` documentation to state that `radius` is the size of the square's edges.
- [UUM-158892] Fixed the `SplineUtility.EvaluateNurbs` documentation to state that `t` is a ratio between 0 and 1 along the knot vector's range.
- [UUM-158682] Fixed `CurveUtility.CalculateLength` and `CurveUtility.GetNearestPoint` returning 0 and Infinity when `resolution` is 1.
- [UUM-158684] Fixed `SplineUtility.EvaluateCurvature` and `CurveUtility.EvaluateCurvature` returning NaN on straight curves.
- [UUM-158692] Fixed `SplineUtility.ReverseFlow` changing the spline's shape in a scaled `SplineContainer`.
- [UUM-158673] Fixed `SplineUtility.JoinSplinesOnKnots` not throwing an `ArgumentException` when the knots cannot be joined.
- [UUM-158694] Fixed `SplineUtility.FitSplineToPoints` exceeding the error threshold when the first knot points along world Z.
- [UUM-158674] Fixed `SplineUtility.SplitSplineOnKnot` leaving a partial spline when the spline or knot index equals `Count`.
- [UUM-158681] Fixed `SplineUtility.SetPivot` moving knots when the `SplineContainer` is rotated, scaled or has several splines.
- [UUM-158699] Fixed `SplineAnimate` logging an unsupported alignment mode message on every update when its alignment mode is set to World Space.
- [UUM-158696] Fixed `SplineData.RemoveDataPoint` removing the first data point and returning true when no data point exists at the given index.
- [UUM-158693] Fixed `BezierKnot.Transform` returning an incorrect knot rotation when the matrix combines a rotation with a scale other than 1.
- [UUM-158672] Fixed `SplineData.ConvertPathUnit` and `SplineData.Evaluate` with a different `PathIndexUnit` moving indices beyond one revolution of a closed spline into the first revolution.
- [UUM-158679] Fixed the `SplineData.AddDataPointWithDefaultValue` and `SplineDataHandles.DataPointHandles` documentation to state that a new data point takes the value of the data point before it.
- [UUM-158893] Fixed the `BezierCurve` linear curve constructor swapping its inner control points.
